title: BuilderReport
description: Builder report describing the outcome of one Work Package implementation turn. Place these fields directly as the tool input — no outer wrapper.

wp_id.description: The Work Package's story_id (the same id used in the input Work Package JSON).

status.description: done: edits were made (or attempted) that should satisfy the Work Package's verification predicates. no_changes_needed: the repository already satisfies the WP — no edits required. blocked: you could not complete the WP (unclear brief, missing authorization, infeasible predicate, etc.) — populate `blockers` with one entry per reason.

edits.description: One entry per file you created, modified, or deleted in this turn. Empty when status is `no_changes_needed` or `blocked` with zero attempted edits.

operation.description: create: new file. modify: existing file changed. delete: file removed.

intent.description: One short sentence explaining what this edit accomplishes and which brief or WP element it traces to.

blockers.description: Required when status is `blocked`. One sentence per blocker — what stopped you, and what authorization or clarification would unblock the WP. Empty list when status is not `blocked`.

summary.description: Up to four sentences describing what you changed and why. The diff is the primary record — keep prose minimal.
